sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Bubble Shooter - Puzzle is a simple yet addictive game. The game's objective is to shoot bubbles of the same color in groups of three or more to clear the board. Sounds easy, right? Well, it is, but it's also incredibly challenging. As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly difficult, with more bubbles being added to the board and new obstacles being introduced.

         One of the key features of Bubble Shooter - Puzzle is its use of different types of bubbles. Each bubble has a different color and point value, and some bubbles are even special, with unique abilities such as freezing or shattering other bubbles. This adds a whole new level of strategy to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to maximize their score.

         Another key feature of Bubble Shooter - Puzzle is its use of power-ups and boosters. These can be earned by completing levels or purchased with coins, and they can be used to give players a temporary advantage. Power-ups such as the 'rainbow bubble' that clears all bubbles of the same color, or the 'freeze bubble' that freezes other bubbles in place, can be a game-changer and give players the edge they need to progress to the next level.
